title: Benjamin Libet's neural timing studies

tellings.quote: this is the the Benjamin libbit work back in the 70s and 80s his those landmark studies that he did

plain: In the 1970s and 1980s a scientist named Benjamin Libet ran studies on the timing of activity in the brain, which the writer Eric Wargo calls "landmark studies". Wargo raises them with Michels during a talk about synchronicities and prophetic dreams, as work that bears on how the mind experiences time. He names Libet but says nothing more about what the studies found.
